spans.s: कु-कर्मन् n. a bad deed, a mean act.
कुकभ n. A kind of spirituous liquor.
कुकील m. A mountain.
कुकु(कू)द m. One who gives away a girl in marriage with due ceremony and suitable decorations.
कुकु(कू)द m. One who gives away a girl in marriage with due ceremony and suitable decorations.
कुकुंद(दु)र n. The cavity of the loins just above the hips. (See ककुंदर.)
कुकुंद(दु)र n. The cavity of the loins just above the hips. (See ककुंदर.)
कुकुर m. pl. Name of a country otherwise called दशार्ह.
कुक्कुर m. (fem. ˚री) A dog, यस्यैतच्चन कुक्कुरैरहरहर्जंघांतरं चर्व्यते Mrich.ii.
कुकूल (I) m.n. 1. Chaff, अयं क्व च कुकूलाग्निकर्कशो मदनानलः K.Pr.x.; 2. a fire made of chaff.
कुकूल (II) n. 1. A hole, a ditch; 2. armour, mail.
कुक्कुट m. 1. A cock, a wild cock; 2. a whisp of lighted straw, a firebrand; 3. a spark of fire.

कुक्कुटि(टी) f. Hypocrisy^1, interested observance of religious duty.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260516. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/224.

कुक्कुटि(टी) f. Hypocrisy^1, interested observance of religious duty.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260516. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/224.
कुक्कुटी f. A hen.
कुक्कुभ m. 1. A wild cock; 2. a cock in general.
कुक्कुर-वाच् m. a species of deer.
कुक्ष m. The belly.

कुक्षि m. 1. The belly, the womb, the part of the belly containing the fœtus, विपुलेन सागरशयस्य कुक्षिणा Sis.xiii.40, R.xv.15; 2. the interior of any thing (in R.x.65, the word is used in senses 1 and 2); 3. a cavity in general; 4. a cavern, a cave, R.ii.38, 67; 5. the sheath of a sword.
कुक्षिंभरि a. one whose only care is to nourish his belly, voracious.
कुक्षि-शूल m. bellyache, colic.
